purpose: Navigation registry for the belief atlas. Keeps political ideologies, religious traditions and nonreligious worldviews addressable without collapsing them into one taxonomy.

layers.name: Religious traditions and worldviews
layers.coordinate_system: separate religious layer; no political score is implied by religious identity

navigation_policy: Every entry receives a stable slug and can be opened from the belief compass. Political entries have analytical compass coordinates. Religious entries remain independently classified and are presented through a dedicated map layer rather than being assigned political beliefs merely because religion and politics can interact.
research_principles: attach primary and scholarly sources to definitions
avoid treating labels as descriptions of every adherent
